name: canary-token-trip-respond
description: G'-prime Workflow C: On Canarytokens trip event webhook, generate AI brief via LLM, write record to attacker-intel DB, notify via Telegram. No active response (observe-only). Tracking: OPS-573.

triggers.name: Canarytokens Webhook
triggers.label: Canarytokens.org trip webhook
triggers.description: Receives HTTP POST from Canarytokens.org when a token is tripped. Fields: src_ip, useragent, memo, token_type.

actions.name: Parse canary trip event
actions.label: Extract key fields from Canarytokens webhook

actions.name: Generate AI brief
actions.label: Ask LLM to summarize the canary trip context

parameters.name: messages
parameters.value:
[{"role": "system", "content": "You are a security analyst. Summarize this Canarytokens trip in 3 sentences. Note any suspicious indicators."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Source IP: $exec.body.src_ip
User-Agent: $exec.body.useragent
Token memo: $exec.body.memo
Token type: $exec.body.token_type
Timestamp: $exec.body.time"}]

actions.name: Write canary trip to attacker-intel DB
actions.label: Insert canary event into attacker_intel.canary_trips

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: INSERT INTO attacker_intel.canary_trips (token_id, token_type, src_ip, useragent, memo, ai_brief, tripped_at) VALUES ('$exec.body.token_id', '$exec.body.token_type', '$exec.body.src_ip', '$exec.body.useragent', '$exec.body.memo', '$ai-brief.choices[0].message.content', NOW());
